cells.gaps: No source found says rules have been made under Law 34/2014. The Ombudsman reports most provinces late with their 2024 implementation reports.
cells.note: The Ombudsman reports on the law to the Assembly and runs its monitoring, and the national archives body compiles public bodies' implementation reports, so a body has taken up oversight, read as Nigeria's Ministry of Justice is. The Ombudsman's count of 60,433 requests in 2024 is inside three years, so every step is met.
